en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a small wooden church with shingled exterior walls and a steep gabled roof, seen from the front entrance. A hedge-lined path leads to the doorway. Leafy trees surround the church and a cemetery is partly visible to the left. In the lower left corner is the printed caption "Näshults kyrka." In the lower right corner is a photographer/publisher imprint inside an oval cartouche and some Swedish text.
